name: SMAG Mobile Antenna Masts AG
summary: SMAG Mobile Antenna Masts AG designs, develops, manufactures, and sells mobile antenna mast systems for military and defense applications. The company provides communications equipment solutions that are critical to deployment and ensure connectivity across the digital battlefield, such as self-supporting and guy-wire-free mobile antenna mast systems. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Salzgitter, Germany. SMAG Mobile Antenna Masts GmbH is a former subsidiary of SMAG Group GmbH.
